system.title: System Settings
system.description: Manage global application configuration and integrations

backupRetention.title: Instance Backup Retention
backupRetention.label: Recent backups to keep
backupRetention.description: Keep the latest 1–100 backups. Older archives are pruned after a new backup passes validation.

backupInterval.title: Automatic Backup Interval
backupInterval.label: Automatic backup interval (hours)
backupInterval.description: Use 24 hours for daily backups or 168 for weekly backups. The maximum is 8760 hours. Set to 0 for manual backups only.
backupInterval.invalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 8760 (0 to disable).

onlineRestore.title: Online restore
onlineRestore.label: Allow in-place restore
onlineRestore.description: Available only to administrators on POSIX systems. Restart the service after changing this setting.

preMigrationBackup.title: Backup before schema migrations
preMigrationBackup.label: Archive data before migrating
preMigrationBackup.description: Disable only if another tool has already backed up both the database and system keys.

backup.title: Instance Backup Policy
backup.description: Configure retention limits and automated backup schedules (backups default to backups under the data directory).

baseUrl.title: Public Base URL
baseUrl.label: Public base URL
baseUrl.description: Include the full path for subpath deployments.

timezone.title: Global timezone
timezone.label: System timezone
timezone.description: Maintenance windows and charts use this timezone.

queue.title: Concurrency & Scheduling
queue.description: Decide how much deployment and recovery work runs at once and how often queued work is polled.

mutationConcurrency.title: Shared deploy and recovery concurrency
mutationConcurrency.label: Concurrent mutations
mutationConcurrency.description: Deployments and restores share this limit.

workerPollSeconds.title: Worker polling interval
workerPollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
workerPollSeconds.description: How often queued work is re-checked for free capacity, retries and scheduled runs.

inbound.title: Network Configuration
inbound.description: Trust forwarded proxy headers, allow cross-origin callers and protect the metrics endpoint.

forwardedAllowIps.title: Trusted reverse proxies
forwardedAllowIps.label: Proxy address
forwardedAllowIps.description: Peers whose forwarded scheme and client address are trusted for login throttling and secure sessions. Set * only when every peer is a proxy.
forwardedAllowIps.invalid: Enter IP addresses or CIDR ranges, or use * on its own.

corsOrigins.title: Allowed CORS origins
corsOrigins.label: Origin
corsOrigins.description: Explicit http(s) origins allowed to call the API from a browser. Leave empty to refuse every cross-origin request.
corsOrigins.invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS origin.

metricsToken.title: Metrics scrape token
metricsToken.label: Token
metricsToken.description: Bearer token that Prometheus-style scrapers send to the metrics endpoint.
metricsToken.saveFailed: Could not save the token. Try again.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.label: Backend log level
logLevel.description: The service uses this log level after startup.

pullGrace.title: Image pull grace period
pullGrace.label: Grace period (seconds)
pullGrace.description: How long a new rollout observation waits for images to be pulled before it starts checking readiness. Observing records keep the deadline they started with.

runtimeHealth.title: Deployment health inspections
runtimeHealth.label: Inspection interval (seconds)
runtimeHealth.description: Check readiness at this interval after deployment. Set to 0 to disable ongoing checks.
runtimeHealth.invalid: Enter 0 to disable or an interval from 300 to 86400 seconds.

releaseHistoryCount.title: Tracker Release History
releaseHistoryCount.label: Versions per release channel
releaseHistoryCount.description: Each channel keeps its latest versions. Older records are pruned daily at 02:00 or after a maintenance window.
releaseHistoryCount.cleanupSuccess: Release history cleanup completed. Deleted {{count}} records.

snapshotHistoryCount.title: Executor Runtime Snapshots
snapshotHistoryCount.label: Snapshots per executor
snapshotHistoryCount.description: Snapshots record runtime settings and image tags before and after deployment. Older snapshots are pruned when a new one is saved.
snapshotHistoryCount.cleanupSuccess: Snapshot history cleanup completed. Deleted {{count}} snapshots.

fakeIp.title: Trusted IP ranges
fakeIp.label: IP range
fakeIp.description: Use IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs. Leave empty to use the default rules.
fakeIp.invalid: Invalid CIDR or range includes a protected address.

ociRegistryRedirects.title: OCI registry redirects
ociRegistryRedirects.label: Enable registry redirect compatibility
ociRegistryRedirects.description: Enable if your registry requires redirects.
ociRegistryRedirects.disabledHint: Requests that receive a redirect are rejected.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Manage version sorting and data fetching preferences
general.versionSortModeDesc: Choose how the system picks the latest version from tracking records
general.fetchLimitDesc: The maximum number of records to fetch per check. Higher limits are useful for projects that release frequently.

oidc.title: OIDC Login Providers
oidc.dialogDesc: Configure an OpenID Connect provider for user login
oidc.requiredFields: Please fill in all required fields
oidc.secretRequired: Client secret is required when creating a provider
oidc.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Existing users will no longer be able to log in with this provider.
oidc.bindingDescription: Only the explicitly bound OIDC identity can sign in as the administrator.
oidc.bindingPasswordDescription: Re-enter the local administrator password before changing the OIDC binding.
